opennyai_summary.final__decision:
On due consideration, the application is allowed and the defect no.5 so pointed out by the office is hereby ignored.
This criminal appeal is preferred challenging the conviction and sentence dated 16.04.2025 in Special Case No.11/2018 by the Special Judge SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989 Ratlam arising out of Crime No.378/2018 registered at Police Station Industrial Area, Jaora, Ratlam (M.P.) for committing penetrative sexual assault repeated during the period 30.08.2018 and 07.09.2018 with the victim/PW-1 belonging to the Scheduled Tribe.
2.
The appellant has been convicted under section 376 (2)\(n) and under Section 384 of of the IPC and sentenced for 10 years R.I. and 02 Years R.I. with fine and default stipulation with section 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and sentenced for 10 years R.I. with fine and default stipulation whereas the minimum sentence under section 3(2)(v) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989 is "Life Imprisonment" as mentioned below:-
2 CRA-6724-2025 "(v) commits any offence under the Indian Penal Code (45 of 1860) punishable with imprisonment for a term of ten years or more against a person or property knowing that such person is a member of a Scheduled Caste or a Scheduled Tribe or such property belongs to such member
, shall be punishable with imprisonment for life and with fine."
3.Since the sentence under Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989 has been passed against the the sentence prescribed under Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST (POA) Act, 1989.
Let an explanation be called from the concerned.
In the meantime, record be called for.
